outcome: IgE sensitization to specific foods, pollen, and animal antigens
cohort: 1223 high-risk children whose mothers received probiotics or placebo from 36 gestational weeks until delivery, and the infants received pre- and probiotics or placebo from birth until 6 months.
finding: Perinatal use of a mixture of probiotics did not affect the prevalence of IgE sensitization to any tested allergen but was associated with more frequent IgE sensitization to cat/dog dander at 13 years in high-risk children.
